notes.title: Egg Hunts!
notes.content:
Hey folks! We just posted a new update to the Birdigo demo, featuring:

[h3]EGG HUNTS[/h3]
Challenging (optional) side quests that gives you a significant [i]permanent[/i] upgrade. For example, an additional word per round, or an extra letter card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495977/453c0b5112b0a94d2788ee5bbd332e146e86e04b.jpg[/img]

[h3]KEYBOARD BRILLIANCE[/h3]
In case you missed it from the last update, Birdigo has great support for keyboards! You can play a complete migration without your fingers ever leaving the keys.

[h3]ALSO![/h3]
- Many new Feathers
- Many new Songs
- New environments, from the arctic to the tropics
- Restockable Trading Posts
- LOTS of rebalancing*

* Many feather values have been adjusted, but also the word length upgrades have been tamed dramatically. They used to upgrade by 1.5x every 5 hands played, and now they increase +1. They're still an important consideration, but no longer dominate the outcome of a given migration.  

If you have any questions or suggestions or criticisms, please reach out! We want to hear about it.

tags.feature: - Many new Feathers
- Many new Songs
- New environments, from the arctic to the tropics
- Restockable Trading Posts

They used to upgrade by 1.5x every 5 hands played, and now they increase +1. They're still an important consideration, but no longer dominate the outcome of a given migration.

notes.title: Typing as input! + migration path balancing
notes.content:
We've just pushed a new patch - here's some info about it.

       We've been delighted to get a few requests for typing as an input method since we launched the demo. As of the latest patch, you can now type to select letters! Enter/Return to play a word, Delete to discard, Backspace to deselect letters. It's very efficient.

     A few players have told us that the early game was too hard, or that migrations would fail due to bad luck, and we agree. The first path (Swainson's Hawk) should be consistently beatable once you know the game well, and that wasn't always the case, so we rebalanced the target points with that in mind.

We also decided to rename the "SPEED" multiplier to "POWER". Some players will inevitably interpret "SPEED" to be related to how fast you input the word, and that's not the case. There's no efficiency or timing-based aspect to the game.

[list]
[*] Target points now taper off more throughout your migration
[*] "SPEED" is now called "POWER"
[*] Support typing as an input method
[*] Added a few words to the wordlist that were reported absent
[*] Feathers are now reorderable, as it can have an impact on gameplay
[*] Fixed a bug where upgraded letters would lose their new class
[/list]

tags.feature: Support typing as an input method

tags.balance_change: Target points now taper off more throughout your migration

tags.feature: Added a few words to the wordlist that were reported absent
Feathers are now reorderable, as it can have an impact on gameplay

notes.title: First player feedback patch!
notes.content:
Hey all! 

First off - thank you to the first wave of [i]Birdigo[/i] players (and your feedback), we're so excited to keep evolving this game. We just patched in a handful of new fixes and improvements (see below). A lot of these stemmed from player reports and suggestions, so please keep those coming!

[list]
[*] Deck button is now clickable while choosing a reward
[*] Mimic feather now copies the card's class as well as its letter(s)
[*] Fixed Applejack feather's scoring value
[*] Fixed letters getting stuck in limbo between 'selected' and 'not selected'
[*] Added a confirmation step at trading posts when replacing an existing feather or song
[*] Fixed UI navigation when switching between gamepad and mouse
[*] If you try to use a song and you havent met its criteria, a popup explains that to you
[/list]

If you get a chance, please wishlist the game and/or leave a review for the demo! it really helps us get visibility in the Steam algorithm. 

Thanks for reading,
Corey
